newsitem.title: DENMARK: Lauritzen unit to buy Zurn Energy.
newsitem.headline: Lauritzen unit to buy Zurn Energy.

text.p: Danish shipping and engineering group J.Lauritzen said on Monday that its Aalborg Industries boiler-making unit had signed a letter of intent to buy U.S. company Zurn Industries' unit Zurn Energy Division.
A Lauritzen statement said that terms of the deal were confidential, adding that Zurn Energy had annual turnover of approximately 300 million Danish crowns and employed 114 staff.

The U.S. firm supplies and services industrial boilers but does not have production facilities and Lauritzen said that the takeover offered savings in development and marketing costs and better utilisation of Aalborg Industries' production capacity.
The acquisition would give Aalborg Industries turnover of around 1.7 billion crowns and a payroll of more than 1,700, the statement said. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
